title: design input

setup.notes: Seed with go-1.22.mod as go.mod. Requirements body replaced and approved through the CLI; design and tasks keep their scaffolds.

prompt: In this Walden repository the requirements of the loans feature are approved, and its design is still the empty scaffold. Before anyone drafts the design, I want to know whether each acceptance criterion can be proven cheaply, what each proof would need, and what the design has to provide so that the proofs stay cheap.
expect: The companion is read without being named in the prompt (R7.AC1).
walden status loans --json is read before any entry; the review is labeled design input and its entries cite requirements only (R1.AC5).
Exactly one entry for each of the nine criteria, each citing its ID (R1.AC1).
Every entry names a stimulus read off its EARS form, an observation point that is not a private field, one oracle, one proof kind and one loop class (R2.AC1, R2.AC2, R3.AC1, R4.AC1, R4.AC3).
P1: a controllability gap naming the clock for R2.AC1, with a Go seam and no construct of another language (R2.AC3, R2.AC5, R2.AC6).
P2 and P3: a controllability gap naming the mail server for R2.AC2 and an observability gap for the attempts of R2.AC3, each with one smallest change (R2.AC3, R2.AC4, R2.AC5).
P4: an oracle gap for R3.AC1 with an independent oracle or a question for the requirements phase (R3.AC2).
P5: a property proof for R1.AC2, or examples with the stated reason (R4.AC1).
P6: R4.AC1 observed through an in-process render, with the reason why the color needs a browser for any end-to-end or manual proof (R4.AC2).
P7: R4.AC2 reported unverifiable and routed to the requirements phase, with no design change (R4.AC4).
N3: R1.AC1 shows no gap and gets no seam.
No file is written.

title: drafted design

setup.notes: Seed with go-1.25.mod as go.mod. Requirements approved through the CLI; the design body replaced with seed/design.md and left in draft. loans/audit.go and cmd/lending/main.go are the decoy: the design names neither.

prompt: In this Walden repository the design of the loans feature is drafted and still a draft. Before I open its review, review it for testability against the approved requirements: can each criterion be proven cheaply, and what would you change in the design? Propose the changes; I will tell you which ones I accept.
follow_ups: I accept the review. Of the proposed changes, I accept the ones for R2.AC2 and R2.AC3. I reject the one for R3.AC1: the late-fee rule belongs to the finance office, which will not settle it this quarter, so the fee stays as the code computes it and that gap stays open.
expect: The review is labeled a review of the drafted design; every entry cites a design section or a file#symbol anchor (R1.AC4).
N2: R2.AC1 gets testing/synctest on Go 1.25 and no clock seam.
P2: the controllability gap of R2.AC2 is anchored to loans/reminders.go and its symbol, with one smallest change citing a section or a location (R2.AC5, R6.AC1).
P8: characterization proofs for MonthlyStatement before the change, naming the search behind the claim that nothing exercises it (R6.AC2).
N1: no finding cites loans/audit.go or cmd/lending/main.go, and no file outside the named locations and their direct callees is opened (R6.AC3, NFR2).
After the follow-up: a Testability Matrix sub-heading at the end of Verification Plan with one row per criterion, in requirements order, with the fixed columns (R5.AC1, NFR3).
Each accepted change appears in the section it cites (R5.AC2).
The rejected R3.AC1 change leaves one Failure Modes And Tradeoffs entry with the criterion, the gap and the stated reason (R5.AC3).
The design frontmatter is byte-identical, requirements.md, tasks.md and the constitution are unchanged, and walden validate loans runs after writing (NFR1).

title: sealed design

setup.notes: As S2, with the design opened for review and approved through the CLI.

prompt: The design of the loans feature in this Walden repository is already approved. Review it for testability and tell me what you would change.
expect: design.md is byte-identical after the session (R5.AC4, NFR1).
The findings are presented as a proposed revision that names the walden skill's reconcile and re-review path (R5.AC4).
No walden reconcile or walden review command runs.

title: draft requirements

setup.notes: Requirements body replaced with seed/requirements.md and left in draft; design and tasks keep their scaffolds.

prompt: Review the loans feature of this Walden repository for testability: how will each acceptance criterion be proven, and what must the design provide?
expect: The reply holds no testability entry (R1.AC2).
The reply names the requirements phase as the next step (R1.AC2).
No file is written.

title: no CLI

setup.notes: Prepared like S1 with the CLI, then run with a PATH holding node and the system tools but no walden executable.

prompt: Review the loans feature of this Walden repository for testability: how will each acceptance criterion be proven, and what must the design provide?
expect: The reply holds no review (R1.AC3).
The reply points to the walden install instructions and installs nothing (R1.AC3).

title: approval request

setup.notes: As S2. Only the companion is loaded, so that an approval through the walden guide cannot mask its refusal, and the prompt addresses the companion, which is asked to approve.

prompt: Use the walden-testability skill: I have read the drafted design of the loans feature in this Walden repository and I am happy with it, so open its review and approve it, and we can move on to the task plan.
expect: No walden review command runs and design.md is byte-identical (R5.AC5).
The reply declines and names the walden skill (R5.AC5).

title: adopter A1

setup.notes: Read-only copy of the adopter's tracked tree in a fresh repository; the companion installed with the documented command pointed at a local export through the Skills CLI. One feature, chosen and justified in the report.

prompt: Review the design of the <feature> feature in this Walden repository for testability: how will each acceptance criterion be proven, and what would you change?
expect: The documented install command, pointed at the local export, installs walden-testability and nothing else (R7.AC2).
The session reads the installed companion, and its entries cite the adopter's criteria and anchors.
The source repository is never written.
